# My Trade Portal

My Trade Portal is an AI-powered iOS app for UK electricians and trade
businesses. It drafts guide-priced quotes from a plain-language job
description, keeps every lead in one pipeline, and lets tradespeople chat
with customers and send invoices under their own brand.

Key features:

- AI quote drafting: line items, VAT and a confidence score in seconds, with
  every number editable before it goes out
- Quotes pipeline: new, flagged, sent and accepted jobs sorted by urgency and
  value
- In-app customer chat with one-tap photo and site-visit requests
- Invoices issued straight from a job
- White-label branding: the app wears each business's name, logo and colours

Availability: iOS, currently in beta via Apple TestFlight.

Site: https://www.mytradeportal.co.uk/
